results.content: Floridians’ expectations about future economic conditions also deteriorated. Expectations for personal financial situations a year from now experienced the steepest drop, falling 3.8 points from 83.9 to 80.1. Expectations regarding U.S. economic conditions over the next year declined 1.3 points from 69.8 to 68.5. Meanwhile, expectations of U.S. economic conditions over the next five years decreased 2.2 points from 74.7 to 72.5. These views were broadly shared across sociodemographic groups. # Lower inflation doesn't spell relief. Here’s why.

August 18, 2026•4 min read

Author: Nela Richardson, Ph.D.

Hard data and personal perceptions don’t always tell the same story about the economy.

Last week, we learned that the pace of inflation cooled in July. But we also saw consumer sentiment fall 12.4 percent in August from the previous year.
